# makefile-doc

> Document Makefiles from their ## comments: aligned help output, a Markdown table kept in sync between README markers, sections and a check for undocumented targets Python package `trysac-makefile-doc`, import name `makefile_doc`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions, limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests

## Optional

- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): tools used and discarded
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): release history
